summary: Executed backend pytest regression and frontend Playwright validation on public preview URL. Backend API contract and Mongo persistence passed; frontend core flows mostly passed with one UX/validation gap and one minor anchor-offset issue.

ui_bugs.issue: Inline error element is not shown for empty/short required fields because native HTML constraint validation prevents submit handler from running.

issues: Collection anchor lands with ~189px top offset after nav click; section heading starts lower than expected.

action_items: Unify form validation UX: show inline errors for required/min-length violations instead of relying only on browser-native validation bubbles.
Tune anchor offset behavior (Lenis anchors offset + CSS scroll-padding-top) to reduce extra top gap on collection jump.
critical_code_review_comments: Lead form currently mixes browser-native constraints and custom submit validation, causing inconsistent error rendering path for required/minLength cases.
Anchor scrolling config has overlapping offsets (Lenis offset and CSS scroll-padding-top), causing measurable jump in section alignment.
seed_data_creation: Created and auto-cleaned TEST_ leads during pytest; UI success flow created TEST_UI lead(s) in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite is reusable and passing (15/15). Frontend console/page errors were not observed. Responsive overflow checks passed for 390x844, 375x812, 768x1024, 1366x768, 1920x800. Mobile hero/bottle visibility looked good in captured artifacts. Recheck inline validation expectations and anchor vertical alignment after fixes.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (inline validation): ContactDialog uses required/minLength attributes on inputs plus custom submit-time setError checks. Browser constraint validation can block form submit event before custom logic, so contact-error is not rendered for certain invalid states. Mitigation: disable native validation (noValidate) and centralize validation in JS, or map native validity state to inline errors. RCA-2 (anchor offset): Lenis anchors offset=-85 combined with html scroll-padding-top:95px leads to cumulative visual offset (~189px observed), making anchor target appear lower than expected.
